items.title: Pay for private register entry (offer only, no obligation)
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date, 01.12.2026, as the payment deadline. 1 Dec 2026 is a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no shift applies. However, the letter itself states it is only an 'Angebot' (offer) and that a contract is formed only if and when the recipient pays ('Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande'). There is therefore no existing legal obligation to pay by this date — it is merely the date the sender proposes for accepting the offer, should the recipient choose to do so.

warnings: This is not an invoice for an obligation already owed: the sender itself states it is an 'Angebot' (offer) and that 'ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande' (a contract is only formed once you pay) — paying would voluntarily create a paid contract for a private, non-official listing.

The sender's name and format ('Grundstücksregister', 'Eintragungen für Grundeigentümer') are designed to look like an official German land registry (Grundbuch) notice; the letter itself admits 'Die Eintragung erfolgt im privaten Verzeichnis des Absenders und steht in keinem Zusammenhang mit dem amtlichen Grundbuch' (the entry is in the sender's private directory and has no connection to the official land register). This matches a well-known German scam/aggressive-marketing pattern (similar to fake 'Gewerbeauskunft-Zentrale' mailings) targeting property owners shortly after a purchase or registration.

Recommend not paying this invoice; there is no legal requirement to be listed in this private register, and genuine land-registry (Grundbuch) matters are handled only by the local Amtsgericht/Grundbuchamt, which does not bill like this.

The IBAN printed (DE59 5007 0010 0005 5707 00) is well-formed and German, but a valid IBAN does not confirm who controls the account; given the offer's dubious nature, do not transfer money based on this letter.
